# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Over sixty years old during the events of Volume 1, passing away at around seventy.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is described as an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure and stooping shoulders. He has long, iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders and a full, soft brown beard which he has worn since he was twenty. He generally wears plain farm clothes, but dresses up in his best suit and a white collar on rare occasions when leaving Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is extraordinarily shy, silent, and reclusive, dreading strangers and particularly all women except his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Despite his bashfulness, he possesses a deeply kind, sympathetic, and indulgent nature, especially toward Anne Shirley. He is quiet and persistent in his convictions, preferring to avoid arguments or confrontation whenever possible.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074)_

- Extremely shy and reclusive  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and agricultural work  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Goals

- To adopt a boy to help him with farm labor at Green Gables due to his advancing age and heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- To ensure Anne's happiness and provide her with nice things  <sub>[v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lives at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Due to his failing health and advancing age, he and Marilla decide to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to help on the farm. Upon going to the Bright River station to fetch the boy, he finds eleven-year-old Anne Shirley instead and brings her home, unable to break the news of the mistake to her himself. Captivated by her chatter, Matthew quietly insists to Marilla that they keep the orphan girl. Throughout Anne's upbringing, Matthew acts as her constant champion and confidant, secretly indulging her wishes, such as buying her a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas. When Anne passes her college entrance exams and later wins the Avery Scholarship, Matthew expresses immense pride in her achievements. Shortly after Anne completes her studies at Queen's Academy, the Abbey Bank fails, wiping out the Cuthbert family savings; the shock causes Matthew to collapse and die instantly of heart failure. He is buried in the Avonlea graveyard.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c32 P46](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0046), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)_
